Package dev.relism.flash.http

Class Request

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.http.Request
public class Request extends Object
An incoming request, read in place from the connection's buffer. One instance per connection (HTTP/1.1) or stream (HTTP/2), repositioned over every request rather than allocated. 

 app.get("/users/{id}", (req, res) -> {
     long id   = req.paramLong("id");            // /users/42  → 42, parsed from the bytes
     int  page = req.queryInt("page", 1);        // ?page=2    → 2
     String accept = req.header("Accept");
     InputStream in = req.body().stream();       // straight off the socket
 });

Do not keep it past the handler: the same instance describes the next request as soon as this one's handler returns. The Strings it hands out are copies and safe to keep. With ServerConfig.dev on, any use after the handler returned throws at the offending call.
